name: Maine
agency: Maine Department of Inland Fisheries and Wildlife

rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1999 needs a boater safety course to run a motorboat over 25 hp (from age 12) or a PWC (from age 16).
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1999 o después necesita un curso de seguridad náutica para manejar una lancha de más de 25 hp (desde los 12 años) o una moto acuática (desde los 16).

minAge.note: Under 12: alone under 10 hp; 10-25 hp only with supervision. No PWC under 16.

card.feeNote: IFW lists the BoatUS course as free (donation requested) and paid online courses.

sources.quote: A person born on or after January 1, 1999, may not operate a motorboat greater than twenty-five (25) horsepower for recreational boating purposes on inland waters of this State or territorial waters, unless that person is 12 years of age or older and has completed a boater safety and education course.
The Boating Safety Education Card is proof of successful completion of the educational requirements and is valid for life.
A person under 16 years of age may not operate a personal watercraft.
